name: dev-team
description: Reusable role agents you can invoke on demand and chain: a product owner (shape specs, guard scope, cut backlog items), an autonomous senior developer (ship-ready delivery: verified, signed commits, pushed, PR opened), a QA verifier (verify, plan, break), a designer (explore, refine, critique), and a changelog editor (cut, curate, review). The changelog editor and any session that edits a changelog follow the shared changelog skill (one imperative line per entry, grounded in the diff). All five follow the shared work-queue skill — GitHub issues when gh is available, session tasks otherwise — so they can run a fully autonomous fill-queue/drain-queue loop.
